changelog:
- Initial release of Google Social Media Finder.
- Searches Google to discover social media profiles for a person, brand, or username.
- Returns platform name, profile URL, username, bio snippet, and follower count across major platforms (X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, etc.).
- Supports pagination and deduplication of profiles.
- Includes pre-execution checks and execution efficiency best practices.
- Documents operational boundaries and known limitations.
